name: explore-local-fabricators-cost
description: Rules audit (deliberate improvement over the original): Local Fabricators' 'spend 1 trade good or commodity for a mech' is unavailable with 0 TG and 0 commodities (value.unavailable = 'Need 1 trade good or commodity'; the engine refuses it, the legacy handler refuses too and places nothing), and re-enables live once the player gains a trade good (dynamic value), after which it resolves: 1 TG spent, mech placed.
